title: AI Vendor Claim / Procurement X-Ray
question: What would have to be true before this vendor claim could support a procurement decision?
questionStatus: implementation copy derived from canonical job
thesis: A vendor promise becomes decision-ready only when the exact entity, proposition, evidence, scope, consequence, control, commitment, remedy, and correction path are explicit.
thesisStatus: implementation copy derived from canonical job and B-web
limitations: scope-specific verification is not a general endorsement
vendor evidence is not automatically independent evidence
a complete x-ray does not make the procurement decision
